name: 4x4 Bouldering Protocol
description: Bouldering power-endurance protocol — reference session to be done AT the wall.
instructions_excerpt: Pick 4 problems at submax grade (85-90% of max flash). Climb each 4 times back-to-back with ~30s rest between ascents on the same problem; rest ~3 minutes between problems. Total: 16 ascents. This is a gassing workout; stop if form fails.

name: Active Hang / Shoulder Decompression
description: Light loaded hang with active engagement — restorative for pulled shoulders.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a pull-up bar or rings on a sturdy jug. Actively engage the shoulders (no passive hang). Hold 20-30 seconds, rest 30 seconds, repeat 3 times.

name: Adventure-Race Load Carry
description: Loaded carry mixing sandbag, buckets, and odd-object style — AR-specific utility strength.
instructions_excerpt: Shoulder a sandbag 20 m, switch shoulder. Pick up a 50 lb bucket in each hand and carry 20 m. Repeat 3-5 rounds.

name: Airbike Intervals
description: Full-body cardio finisher — lower-body sparing for climbers.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up for 3 minutes easy. 10 rounds of 20 seconds hard / 40 seconds easy. Target max effort on the hard intervals. Cool down 3 minutes.

name: Altitude Box-Step Hypoventilation Sim
description: Step-ups performed with nasal-only breathing and controlled exhale — aerobic-stress under breath restriction.
instructions_excerpt: Step up and down on a knee-height box at 20-30 steps per minute. Breathe only through the nose with slow exhales. 8-12 min.

name: Altitude Breathing Drill (Box Breathing)
description: Box-breath protocol — primary tool for altitude acclimatization and CO2 tolerance.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or lying. Inhale 4s through the nose. Hold 4s. Exhale 4s through pursed lips. Hold empty 4s. Repeat for 5-10 min. Advance to 5-5-5-5 then 6-6-6-6 as tolerated.

name: Altitude CO2 Tolerance Breath-Hold
description: Breath-hold-on-exhale CO2 tolerance drill — safe dryland tool for altitude adaptation prep.
instructions_excerpt: Seated calmly: exhale fully, hold 20-45s, inhale, breathe normally 60s. Repeat 5-8 cycles. Do not force hyperventilation. Stop if lightheaded.

name: Artistic-Swim Sculling Iso
description: Supine sculling practice — artistic swimming specific hand-paddle endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Supine on floor or in water. Arms palms-down at sides, fingertips paddle inward-outward in a continuous figure-8. 45-90s.

name: Backcountry Avalanche-Probe Shovel Drill
description: Repeated shoveling motion from knees — direct transfer to avalanche rescue ability.
instructions_excerpt: From kneeling, shovel snow (or sand) forward and to the side as fast as possible for 60-90s. Alternate sides.

name: Bikejor Harness-Pull Tempo Run
description: Mid-tempo forward lean running with resistance — bikejoring and skijoring prep.
instructions_excerpt: Run against a light resistance band attached to a belt at hip height. 3-5 min at tempo pace.

name: Bilateral Rowing Ergometer Aerobic
description: Steady aerobic rowing-ergometer session — transfers to any paddle sport and swim cross-training.
instructions_excerpt: Rowing erg. 20-40 minutes at conversational pace (can speak in full sentences). Smooth drive, rhythmic recovery. Stroke rate 18-22.

name: BMX Pump-Track Squat Pulse
description: Rhythmic partial-squat pulse mimicking the up/down pumping cadence of a BMX pump track.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in quarter-squat stance, feet wide. Rhythmically pump the hips and arms down-up-down-up at 80-100 bpm for 30-45s, as if loading/unloading a pump-track roller. Arms drive with the pump.

name: Box Breathing 4-4-4-4
description: Parasympathetic breathwork — 4-4-4-4 box pattern for post-game recovery and stress management.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or supine. Inhale through nose for 4 counts. Hold 4 counts. Exhale through nose/mouth for 4 counts. Hold empty 4 counts. Repeat for 3-5 minutes.

name: Breath-Hold Squats (Dry CO2)
description: Air-squat bout with repeated breath holds — CO2 tolerance for freediving and water polo chase sets.
instructions_excerpt: Inhale, hold, squat 10-15 air squats. Exhale, recover. Repeat 6-8 rounds. Build squat count slowly; never push to near-blackout.

name: Brick Run-After-Bike
description: Short run immediately after a bike ride — triathlon transition specificity.
instructions_excerpt: Ride bike 30-60 min at aerobic pace. Immediately change into running gear and run 15-30 min. Focus on leg turnover the first 5 min.

name: Burpee
description: Full-body conditioning move combining squat, plank, push-up, jump.
instructions_excerpt: From standing, drop to a plank via squat. Perform a push-up. Jump feet forward, then explode up into a small jump. Repeat.

name: Calf Raise Endurance (Bilateral High-Rep)
description: High-rep bilateral calf raise — soleus endurance for long uphill days.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall, raise up to toes, lower under control. 25-50 reps per set. Focus on full plantar flexion.

name: Canicross Harness Lean-Pull Drill
description: Trunk-lean forward-pull drill simulating running while attached to a pulling dog.
instructions_excerpt: Attach a band to a fixed anchor behind you at waist height. Run/jog forward against the resistance with hip-belt or canicross harness. 30-60s intervals.

name: Child's Pose
description: Resting posterior-chain and hip flexor decompression.
instructions_excerpt: Kneel with big toes touching and knees apart. Sit hips back on heels and fold torso forward, arms extended overhead on the floor. Relax the head. Hold 30-60 seconds and breathe deeply.

name: CO2 Tolerance Breath-Hold Tables
description: Static breath-hold intervals — trains CO2 tolerance for spearfishing and freediving without an in-water session.
instructions_excerpt: Seated or supine. Inhale, hold breath for 60 sec. Breathe freely 90 sec. Hold 60 sec, breathe 75 sec. Hold 60 sec, breathe 60 sec. Continue reducing breathe intervals. Stop if anxious.

name: CO2 Tolerance Drill (Exhale Hold)
description: Exhale-hold protocol — improves CO2 tolerance, a core altitude-adaptation marker.
instructions_excerpt: Sit tall. Take 3 normal breaths. On the third exhale, hold empty until the first real urge to breathe. Recover 60s. Repeat 5-8 rounds. Track time and progress weekly.

name: Court Burst Interval
description: Short repeat sprints that mimic the 5-15 second rally bursts of racquet sports — energy-system specific conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: On a court or open space, sprint hard for 10-15 seconds, then walk/rest for 30-45 seconds. Repeat for 8-12 bursts. Total work ~12-15 minutes.

name: Cyclocross Shoulder Carry Drill
description: Shoulder-carry run with a bike (or a surrogate load) — the defining cyclocross skill.
instructions_excerpt: Pick up a bike (or 15-30 lb sandbag on your shoulder). Run 20-30 m with it, jog around a cone, run back. 4-6 reps. Focus on smooth mount/dismount.

name: Dance-Fitness Cardio Block
description: Zumba-style dance cardio block — aerobic + coordination for dance-fitness and swing-dance prep.
instructions_excerpt: Follow a 4-song cardio block of mixed steps (side tap, grapevine, mambo). Keep moving through low-intensity recovery steps.

name: Dancer Interval Run (Rehearsal Sim)
description: Short-interval aerobic conditioning matched to dance-round timing.
instructions_excerpt: Run, jump rope, or high-knee in place for 2 minutes at hard pace, then rest 1 minute. Repeat 4-6 rounds.

name: Day-Hike Downhill Control Walk
description: Slow downhill walking with focus on knee tracking — day-hike specific eccentric prep.
instructions_excerpt: Walk down a 10-20% slope for 8-12 min at a slow deliberate pace, emphasizing heel strike and quiet knee tracking.

name: Diaphragmatic Breathing Drill
description: Guided nasal diaphragmatic breathing — recovery and parasympathetic activation after hard rounds; also improves breath efficiency under submission pressure.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with a hand on the chest, other on belly. Inhale through the nose slowly (4-5s), letting only the belly rise. Exhale through the mouth (6-8s). Repeat for 3-5 minutes.

name: Double-Pole Ergometer Intervals
description: Nordic-ski ergometer interval — the most direct off-snow trigger of the XC double-pole engine.
instructions_excerpt: On a ski-erg or cable pulldown. Stand tall, then fold forward at the hips, pressing the handles down past the thighs with straight arms, finishing behind the hips. Stand back up tall and reset. 30-60 sec intervals.

name: Double-Under (Jump Rope)
description: Jump rope with two rope passes per jump — CrossFit conditioning staple.
instructions_excerpt: Jump with a jump rope, rotating the wrists fast enough that the rope passes under the feet twice per jump.

name: Downhill Walk (Sub-Max Eccentric)
description: Steady downhill walk on rolling trail — targets quad eccentric capacity for thru-hiking descents.
instructions_excerpt: On a gentle downhill grade (5-15%), walk 30-45 minutes at an easy pace. Land softly, knee-soft. Use poles if available.

name: Dryland Finning Drill
description: Dryland fin kicking drill — freediving and spearfishing hip-driven long fin pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone on a low bench or foam pad with legs hanging off. Perform long, straight-leg flutter kicks originating at the hips. 30-60 sec.

name: Dryland Flutter Kick (Weighted Ankles)
description: Weighted dryland flutter kick — hip-flexor and core endurance for any swim kick base.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, small ankle weights. Press lower back into floor, legs straight. Perform small, fast flutters from the hips for 30-60s. Core braced.

name: E-Bike Sustained Cadence Ride
description: Sustained Zone-2 ride with a target cadence of 80-90 rpm on an e-bike (motor assist at minimum) — conditioning tailored to e-bike riding.
instructions_excerpt: Ride at a steady 80-90 rpm cadence, motor on lowest assist level, for 40-60 min. Breath nasal-only if possible.

name: Fell-Running Steep Ascent Hike-Run
description: Alternating hike and run on steep gradient — fell-running and mountain-run specific.
instructions_excerpt: On a 15-25% gradient, alternate 60s power-hike with 60s run-jog, for 10-20 min. Use poles if available.

name: Finger Glides
description: Low-intensity tendon gliding — post-climbing finger recovery.
instructions_excerpt: Move each finger through: straight → hook fist → straight fist → straight → tabletop → straight. 5 slow reps per finger. Do both hands.

name: Fishing Pack Carry
description: Loaded carry with a fishing pack — strength + trail specific for fly fishing approaches.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a 10-20 lb pack. Walk 400-800 m over uneven terrain. Keep posture tall. Repeat on terrain variability.

name: Flutter Kick (Hollow)
description: Hollow-body flutter kicks — swim-specific core + hip flexor endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, low back pressed into the floor. Legs straight, raised a few inches. Alternate small fast up-down kicks from the hips. 30-60 seconds per set.

name: Fly-Casting Wrist-Flick Drill
description: Wrist-flick with dowel — fly-casting endurance and motor control.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a 2-3 lb dowel like a fly rod. Flick wrist forward-and-back in casting rhythm. 30-60s sets.

name: Foam Roll Adductors
description: Inner-thigh self-myofascial work — adductor recovery for groin-heavy sports (soccer, hockey, rugby).
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down with one leg out to the side, foam roller under the adductor. Slowly roll from groin to knee. Work tender spots for 60-90 sec per side.

name: Foam Roll IT Band
description: Lateral thigh self-myofascial work — addresses the IT band / TFL tightness common in runners and cutters.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on side with foam roller under the outer thigh. Slowly roll from hip to just above knee. Pause 10-20 sec on any tender spot. Work for 60-90 sec per side.

name: Foam Roll Lats
description: Self-myofascial release of the lats — top recovery tool for paddlers with chronically loaded lats.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on one side with the foam roller under the armpit. Extend the arm long overhead. Roll slowly from armpit down to ribcage. 60-90 seconds per side.

name: Foam Rolling (Full Body)
description: Self-myofascial release — general recovery staple.
instructions_excerpt: With a foam roller: roll each major muscle group (quads, IT band, glutes, hamstrings, calves, lats, mid-back) for 45-60 seconds per area. Move slowly; pause on tight spots for 20-30 seconds.

name: Forearm Self-Massage
description: Soft-tissue work on flexors and extensors — post-climb recovery staple.
instructions_excerpt: Rest the forearm on a table. Use the opposite thumb or a lacrosse ball to apply sustained pressure to tight spots on the forearm flexors (palm side) and extensors (back side). Work from elbow toward wrist. 2 minutes per side.

name: Forearm Self-Massage (Grappler)
description: Targeted self-massage of forearm flexors/extensors — resolves post-gi or post-sparring forearm pump.
instructions_excerpt: Sit and place one forearm on the opposite thigh. Use the heel of the other hand or a massage ball to work slowly up and down the forearm flexors and extensors. Spend 2-3 minutes per arm.

name: Forearm Trigger Point Release
description: Targeted self-myofascial release on the forearm flexors and extensors — essential recovery for the tennis-elbow-prone racquet player.
instructions_excerpt: Using a lacrosse ball against a desk or wall (or a massage gun), press into the meat of the forearm. Slowly roll and pause on tight spots for 20-30 seconds. Cover both flexor (palm-side) and extensor (back-of-hand-side) compartments. 2-3 min per arm.

name: Freediving Dry Apnea Walk
description: Walking-while-breath-holding drill — freediving-specific CO2 tolerance under light load.
instructions_excerpt: After a normal breath, walk at easy pace holding breath for 20-40 steps. Breathe normally for 30-60s recovery. 4-6 rounds. Do not overdo.

name: Geocaching Loaded Scramble Walk
description: Loaded steady-state walk over uneven terrain — geocaching and day-hiking general fitness.
instructions_excerpt: Walk 15-30 min over grass/trail/uneven ground with 10-15 lb pack at easy pace.

name: Geocaching Pack Walk
description: Light pack walk on uneven terrain — foundational fitness for geocaching and misc outdoor travel.
instructions_excerpt: With a 5-15 lb pack, walk 45-90 min on varied terrain. Steady pace, hydrate, observe surroundings.

name: Golf-Fitness Carry-Bag Walk
description: Loaded walk with a golf-bag equivalent — prepares for walking 18 holes carrying a bag.
instructions_excerpt: Carry an 18-25 lb bag or sandbag on one shoulder for 10-15 min at walking pace. Switch shoulders halfway.

name: Heavy Bag 3-Minute Round
description: Three-minute heavy bag round — sport-specific striking conditioning that blends technique, power, and cardio.
instructions_excerpt: Work the bag for 3 minutes at a sustainable striking pace (not max power — glycolytic threshold). Mix jabs, crosses, hooks, teeps, and combinations. 1 minute rest. 3-6 rounds total.

name: High-Cadence Spin Intervals
description: Short intervals at very high cadence — neuromuscular smoothness transfer to road/indoor cycling.
instructions_excerpt: On trainer or flat road. 30s at 110-120 rpm (moderate resistance), 60s easy spin. 6-10 reps.

name: Hill Repeats (Uphill Running)
description: Short uphill running repeats — aerobic-power and leg strength for any running niche.
instructions_excerpt: Find a 45-90s hill. Run up at hard effort, walk/jog down. 6-10 reps.

name: Hip 90/90 Breathing Flow
description: Seated 90/90 hip position with paced breathing — recovery mobility for the court-athlete hip.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on the floor with one leg 90° in front (shin parallel to hips) and the other leg 90° to the side. Inhale 4s, exhale 6s. Hold 5-8 breaths. Rotate through the hips to swap sides (a "windshield wiper"). Continue 2-3 minutes.

name: Hip-Hop Bounce Squat
description: Rhythmic shallow squat bounces — groove endurance for hip-hop dance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand wide. Bounce through the knees rhythmically, driving hips down-up in a shallow squat pulse. Coordinate with arm swings if desired. 30-60 seconds.

name: Hypoxic Walk (Nasal Breathing Only)
description: Nasal-breathing-only walk — builds CO2 tolerance and simulates some altitude demand at sea level.
instructions_excerpt: Walk at moderate pace, breathing only through the nose. If you must mouth-breathe, slow down. 20-45 minutes. Add hills as tolerance grows.

name: Indoor Cycling Zone-2 Ride
description: Steady aerobic trainer ride at conversational effort — aerobic base for every cycling discipline.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up 10 min. Ride at conversational pace (can speak in full sentences) for 45-90 min. Keep cadence 85-100 rpm.

name: Indoor-Cycling Seated Threshold Interval
description: Seated threshold interval on an indoor trainer — structured session for Zwift/Peloton users.
instructions_excerpt: On a trainer, ride at 88-92% FTP for 6-10 min, 3-5 min recovery between. 3-4 intervals.

name: Indoor-Cycling Standing Climb Interval
description: Standing out-of-saddle climb interval on an indoor trainer — replicates Zwift/Peloton-style climb work.
instructions_excerpt: On a trainer with moderate resistance (70-80% FTP), ride out of the saddle at 60-70 rpm for 60-90 sec, seated recovery 90 sec. Repeat 4-6x.

name: Irish Dance Sidestep Drill
description: Rapid lateral tapping footwork on the balls of the feet — Irish dance footwork conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall in a tight posture (arms at sides). On the balls of the feet, rapidly sidestep right-left-right-left, tapping lightly and maintaining an upright chest.

name: Irish Dance Toe-Stand Pulse
description: Rise-and-drop calf pulse in toe-stand — Irish dance specific calf conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: Rise to toes, hold 1 sec, lower 1 sec in rhythmic pulses for 45-60 sec. Arms stiff at sides.

name: KB Sport Long-Cycle Breath Drill
description: Kettlebell Sport specific clean+jerk with breath rhythm — teaches the pacing pattern.
instructions_excerpt: With a light kettlebell (8-12 kg), perform clean+jerk every 6-8 sec maintaining a relaxed breath cycle. 1-2 min continuous.

name: Keelboat Grinder Arm Cranks
description: Arm-cranking ergometer or upper-body ergometer intervals — keelboat grinder specificity.
instructions_excerpt: On an upper-body ergometer or arm-crank, perform 30-60s hard bouts alternating arms or two-arm. Rest 60s. 6-10 reps.

name: Keelboat Winch-Grind Simulation
description: Double-arm rotational grinding pattern at waist height — simulates winching on a racing keelboat.
instructions_excerpt: Stand at a cable or band anchored low. Double-hand crank in a forward rotation for 30-60s like a winch. Switch to reverse.

name: Kendo Shinai Swing (Suburi)
description: Large overhead shinai swing from shoulder to target — core kendo conditioning.
instructions_excerpt: Grip a shinai or bokken. From a rear-up position, cut down to eye-level target (men) with a snap. Return overhead. 30-50 reps.

name: Kettlebell Clean-and-Jerk EMOM
description: High-volume kettlebell clean-and-jerk conditioning — kettlebell sport competition staple.
instructions_excerpt: With a moderate kettlebell in each hand (or one arm at a time), perform clean-and-jerks on the minute, every minute for 5-10 minutes. Start with 4-6 reps per minute; target competition pace (6-10/min).

name: Kneeling Ski-Erg Pull
description: Tall-kneeling ski-erg pull — blends pulling power and core bracing for paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Tall-kneel in front of a ski erg. Pull the handles from overhead down to the hips with a full torso engagement. Reset overhead with control.

name: Kneeling Upright Row Endurance
description: Kneeling high-rep kettlebell or DB upright row — shoulder and trap endurance for long paddling days.
instructions_excerpt: Tall-kneel with a KB in one or both hands. Pull the weight up to the collarbone leading with the elbows. 20-30 reps continuous.

name: Lacrosse Cradle Rotation Drill
description: Wrist-and-forearm cradle pattern with a weighted stick — lacrosse-specific.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a weighted stick (3-5 lb) vertically in both hands. Rotate wrists and forearms through a smooth cradle arc. 30-60s sets.

name: Lap-Swim Kick-Board Endurance
description: Long-set flutter kick with board — builds pool lap-swim kick endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Hold kickboard, flutter kick for 4-8 x 50 m at moderate pace. 20-40s rest.
